glow-ball-amber.name: Amber glowing ball
glow-ball-amber.srd: A ball with the Light cantrip on it: bright light in a 20 ft radius and dim light for 20 ft more, for an hour. Glass: it shatters thrown hard (8 m/s or more) or struck, though a drop from the hand doesn't break it.

glow-ball-azure.name: Azure glowing ball
glow-ball-azure.srd: A ball with the Light cantrip on it: bright light in a 20 ft radius and dim light for 20 ft more, for an hour. Glass: it shatters thrown hard (8 m/s or more) or struck, though a drop from the hand doesn't break it.

glow-ball-rose.name: Rose glowing ball

bullseye-lantern.name: Bullseye lantern
bullseye-lantern.srd: Bright light in a 60 ft cone and dim light for 60 ft more, burning a flask of oil. A 5e cone is as wide as it is long (about 53 degrees). Smashing it on landing (8 m/s or harder) splashes its burning oil over the 5 ft square, as a thrown oil flask does: our physical reading.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.srd: Objects viewed through a spyglass are magnified to twice their size.

sending-stone.name: Sending stone
sending-stone.srd: Sending stones come in pairs. Touching one, you can cast Sending to whoever bears the other: a message of 25 words or fewer.

ball.name: Ball
ball.srd: Not from the SRD: a leather ball to kick about the court east of the yard (run into it), or pick up and throw.

pick.name: Pick
pick.srd: A miner's pick: each swing digs a cell one step, rock included, leaving rubble. Metal and bedrock turn it. Our reading: the SRD's pick has no rule for digging.

dancing-lights.name: Dancing Lights mote
dancing-lights.srd: The Dancing Lights cantrip held ready: a mote shedding dim light in a 10 ft radius, moved up to 60 ft to where you point. Our stand-in for a laser pointer.
